role: The abstract packet: id-to-class instantiation for decode, blob read/write helpers, and the encode/decode/process contract every packet implements.
scope_reason: Wire format and connection plumbing: native messages are structs by design (SPEC: messages are structs, not bytes) (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md).

members.name: generatePacket
members.note: Byte-stream decode; the native tick passes message structs (player.h's struct c03, struct client_out) with no id lookup.

members.name: writePacketData
members.note: Abstract; implemented per packet subclass. The one place the format matters natively is the S12 velocity encode, reproduced in survival.c's s12_axis.

members.name: processPacket
members.note: Dispatch to the handler; the native pump (server_player_tick and surv_server_tick_start) applies the same messages in the same order without a Packet object.

members.name: hasPriority
members.note: Only disconnect, login and keep-alive packets override it; none is sent in-process.

notes: The wire format is deliberately not ported: SPEC's native tick design says 'Messages are structs, not bytes'. What is ported is each handler's behavior, under NetHandlerPlayServer's record.
